name: barbell weighted deadlift
description: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.
